themeVariables.fontFamily: Reddit Sans, Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

themeCSS: .nodeLabel, .edgeLabel, .cluster-label { font-family: 'Reddit Sans', Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif !important; font-size: 32px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; } .rough-node .nodeLabel p { border-radius: 8px; } .rough-node.default:not(.success):not(.failure):not(.action) .nodeLabel p { background-color: #30284f !important; } .rough-node.success .nodeLabel p { background-color: #dcfce7 !important; } .rough-node.failure .nodeLabel p { background-color: #fee2e2 !important; } .rough-node.action .nodeLabel p { background-color: #e0f2fe !important; } .flowchart-link { stroke-width: 3px !important; } marker path { fill: #f4f4f5 !important; stroke: #f4f4f5 !important; }
